scope: 18 shared assets from preserved 20+6 placement; generation input only. No PNG transformation, Unity changes or scene completion.

world_view.coordinate_system: building local XYZ metres, Y up, fixed orthographic basis
world_view.projection_shape_rule: A physical cuboid/rectangle envelope is a scale guide. Organic/circular visible alpha may occupy only part of it.

packing.algorithm: stable asset order, row shelf packing, 8 texels on each side; integer floor(min)/ceil(max) projection envelopes

generation_contract.native_feature_rule: Use minimum pixels for legible characteristics. Preserve this global PPU instead of giving every asset a similarly-sized crop.

normalization_contract.algorithm: Unmodified original PerfectPixel auto grid detection, once for the whole sheet
normalization_contract.crop_rule: Detected canonical integer-grid rectangles only. Sheet regions must be mapped to the detected grid before cropping.
forbidden: UV homography to fit generated color
Using guide cells as forced PNG resize destinations
normalization_contract.input_rejection: If automatic grid/physical envelopes/region separation do not support the shared source contract, preserve the failed input and report its specific cause; do not resize to make it pass.

limitations: Collider dimensions are physical placement constraints, not proof of the previous image silhouette.
Clock/poster/broom metrics are prior declared geometry with no current colliders; they are traced explicitly.
Ledger physical thickness at 32 PPU is below one source texel; the exact thickness silhouette cannot be guaranteed.
Existing counter supported-object positions may include the older visual support-height offset. Existing origins are recorded; this file does not alter them.
Generation conditioning does not mathematically guarantee camera/scale/geometry. The generated sheet must supply an appropriate common input before integration.
No hidden 3D surfaces or volumetric depth are recovered from this guide.
